title: Northgate Credit Cards Reward Certificate: Redemption, Expiry and Replacement
content:
Club register and member services reference for the card reward certificate of Northgate Credit Cards once it has been issued.

## Terms

The certificate expires at the end of the card's certificate expiry month of its issue year, is redeemable at a club register — in merchandise, or in cash where the card's terms allow cash redemption — only while the linked membership is active, and must be used in one transaction where the card's terms make it single-use. A lost certificate is reissued at most the number of times the card's terms allow, before it expires, for the same value and expiry. An expired certificate is never reissued, extended or paid.

## Redemption conditions

| Condition | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Where | At a club register |
| In what | Merchandise, or cash where the card's terms allow cash redemption |
| Linked membership | Active at the time of redemption |
| Expiry | Not yet past the end of the expiry month of the issue year |
| Number of transactions | One, where the card's terms make the certificate single-use |

### Membership and expiry together

| Certificate not yet expired | Linked membership active | Redeemable at a club register |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | No | No |
| No | Yes | No |
| No | No | No |

## Replacement of a lost certificate

A reissue voids the lost or undelivered certificate and issues it again for the same value and the same expiry; it is recorded against the original certificate with its reissue date.

- **Count.** The reissues recorded against the original certificate over its life are counted from the card account's records. Once that count has reached the number of reissues the card's terms allow, no further reissue is made.
- **Time.** A reissue is made only before the certificate expires.
- **Value and expiry.** Always those of the original certificate; a reissue never changes either.

## Cases (hypothetical certificates)

- A certificate issued in a hypothetical year 2026 with a December expiry month is presented at a club register on 31 December 2026 while the linked membership is active. It has not yet expired and is redeemable.
- The same certificate presented on 1 January 2027 has expired. It is not redeemed, reissued, extended or paid.
- A certificate worth $62.40 is reported lost in July of its issue year, before expiry, and has never been reissued. Where the card's terms allow at least one reissue, it may be reissued, for $62.40 and with the original expiry.
- A certificate that has already been reissued as many times as the card's terms allow is reported lost again. It is not reissued.
- A certificate presented while the linked membership is expired is not redeemable, even before its expiry date.
